mode.name: Home
mode.desc: Everything on — the full rig at home (default)

presets.name: Ambient echo wash
presets.desc: Long, diffused, dark repeats that melt into a stereo wash behind chords

presets.name: Bass eighth halo
presets.desc: Eighth-note repeats on the bass with the lows cut from the loop: melodic lines echo, the low end stays solid

presets.name: Harmony canon echo
presets.desc: Two long repeats at 800 and 1600 ms, one each side, so a solo harmonises with itself

presets.name: Tight country slap
presets.desc: A very short, bright single repeat that doubles chicken-picked Telecaster lines

presets.name: Dotted-eighth arena
presets.desc: Dotted-eighth digital repeats as loud as the pick, turning picked eighths into a 16th-note pulse

presets.name: Dotted plus quarter cascade
presets.desc: Two delays in one: dotted-eighth and quarter taps interlock into a shimmering 16th-note cascade

presets.name: Dub runaway echo
presets.desc: Dark tape echo near self-oscillation: throws on a snare or a chord that swell into a roar

presets.name: Ducked lead echo
presets.desc: Quarter-note repeats that duck under the solo and bloom in the gaps between phrases

presets.name: Single-repeat tape skank
presets.desc: One loud tape repeat on the off-beat, as loud as the chord: reggae-tinged new wave chops

presets.name: Floating solo echo
presets.desc: A 440 ms tape-like echo with darker repeats that lifts sustained bends into a big space

presets.name: Synth ping-pong
presets.desc: Dotted-eighth ping-pong across the stereo field: arpeggios bounce left and right

presets.name: Crushed 8-bit echo
presets.desc: Early-digital echo whose repeats lose rate and bits each pass, grainier and grainier

presets.name: Reverse halo
presets.desc: Reversed, diffused repeats behind the dry chord: swelling backwards ghosts of what was played

presets.name: Backwards solo
presets.desc: Each phrase comes back reversed, wet only: the backwards-guitar solo without tape tricks

presets.name: Rising shimmer echo
presets.desc: Each repeat climbs an octave and blurs into a rising pad, with pick attacks swelled out

presets.name: Three-head tape rhythm
presets.desc: Tape echo with three playback heads at 1/3, 2/3 and 1 of the time: galloping, warbly rhythms

presets.name: Sun studio slapback
presets.desc: One tape repeat about 135 ms behind the note: the rockabilly and early rock'n'roll slap

presets.name: Long tape accumulator
presets.desc: Four-second tape loop with high feedback: phrases pile up into a slowly decaying drone

presets.name: Tape double tracker
presets.desc: A 25 ms modulated copy, no feedback: artificial double tracking that thickens a single take

presets.name: Fifties vocal slap
presets.desc: A single tape slap about 135 ms behind the voice: the Sun-era rock'n'roll vocal

presets.name: Vocal quarter throw
presets.desc: Ping-pong quarter echoes on the voice, filtered and ducked so the words stay dry and clear

presets.name: Warm analog quarter
presets.desc: Quarter-note bucket-brigade repeats, darker each pass, sitting just behind the playing
